name: Fundraise Up
description: Fundraise Up is a digital fundraising platform for optimized donation checkout, campaigns, recurring giving, supporter management, peer-to-peer fundraising and CRM integrations.
agentUseSummary: Add a granular Fundraise Up API key and run all 35 official operations through pinned routes. Safe runs 18 reads directly and requires approval for 17 mutations; every call explicitly selects provider-required live or test mode.

credentialRequirements.label: Fundraise Up API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a granular API key in Dashboard, Settings, API keys. Relay encrypts it and sends it only to api.fundraiseup.com in the Bearer header.

allowed.label: Read Fundraise Up
allowed.description: Read campaigns, designations, donations, events, fundraisers, recurring plans and supporters.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Fundraise Up
approvalRequired.description: Create or update donations, fundraisers and designations, assign designations, or generate portal and upgrade links; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 18 reads run directly; all 17 mutations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 35 operations run without Relay per-action approval; API-key permissions, live/test mode, fixed routes, audits, bounds and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts all 35 official operations with fixed-origin server-side Bearer authentication.
Relay mounts all 35 official operations with fixed-origin server-side Bearer authentication.

providerSetup.blocker: Live acceptance requires an authorized Fundraise Up account, a granular API key and representative test/live fundraising records.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized administrator generates a least-privilege key, stores it through Relay Console, and validates test/live reads, approved reversible mutations, key replacement/deletion, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in Railway staging.

evidence.supports: The official OpenAPI v1.0.0 documents Bearer API keys, granular permissions, explicit live/test mode, 35 operations, cursor pagination and a three-request account concurrency limit.
Fundraise Up documents the REST API as its supported custom-integration interface for offline donations and data synchronization.
